# VNMSFX

> AI systems consultancy for food & beverage brands, New York. VNMSFX finds the money F&B brands lose — true margin by SKU after slotting and promos, unclaimed distributor deductions, accounts going quiet — with one AI system wired to the tools the brand already uses (Shopify, QuickBooks, HubSpot, Notion, Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Gmail). Built once, owned by the client. Founder: Brandon Adams.

## Engagements
- Free teardown (30 min): you show me where things live; I name two leaks I'd go after first. Book: https://cal.com/vnmsfx/30min
- The leak audit ($2,500): a week inside your numbers; credited toward the build.
- The build ($5,000/mo, 3 months): one piece at a time, biggest leak first; first fix live in week two; training month included.
- The partnership ($1,500/mo, optional, after the build): monthly review, priority fixes, upgrades.

## Terms
Client owns everything — accounts, logins, data, the system itself. No operations taken over, no custom software, no lock-in. Three clients at a time.
